newsitem.title: USA: Justin footwear, building units lead gains.
newsitem.headline: Justin footwear, building units lead gains.

text.p: Justin Industries Inc on Tuedsay said its second quarter earnings growth was led by strength in its building materials and footwear units.
Footwear revenues for the quarter equalled those of 1996 because of gains in the Chippewa line of sport and utility footwear and sales of the new Justin Original Workboot.
But the company noted that sales of Western boots declined during the period.
Building matertial profits were ahead of the prior year as natural gas costs declined and brick pricing improved.
Earlier, Justin reported second quarter income of $0.28 a share, compared with $0.21 a share a year ago.
